ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 70% of the visible surface, framed by low-intensity black pixels along the distal margins, trailing edges, and the central junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central white regions are contiguous across both lobes. Black pigmentation is concentrated along the trailing edge and the medial notch area. Significant tan/brownish hue clusters (likely diatom film) are visible on the inner-left lobe. The right lobe features discrete black linear streaks and small spots on the white interior.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a depth extending roughly 15% into the fluke chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and serrated. The left lobe exhibits a prominent, large semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge. Both lobes show frequent micro-oscillations (peaks and valleys) across the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edges that sweep inward toward the central notch; leading edges are convex, tapering to acute, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel groupings (barnacle colonization) are visible at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear streaks are detected on the right lobe, primarily oriented vertically; several finer horizontal scratches are present on the left lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular indentation/notch is present on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe. Barnacle colonization is heavy on the distal terminals.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown pigmentation patches located in the central-left quadrant of the ventral surface.
